spec.name: Orange Kitchen Pizza Oven
spec.description: Rustic terracotta brick oven on a full-block stone base, with a stepped arch, recessed glowing firebox, projecting warm hearth and soot-dark chimney. Front faces -Z; ground is y0; maximum height is 30.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Pizza Oven. Rustic brick pizza oven over a full block stone base, arched stepped dark oven mouth, glowing coals, smoke chimney and warm stone hearth. Max height30. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
